verdict.rationale: Quo documents its own call-routing features: routing incoming calls to the right person, custom ring orders, call transfers and phone menus. Its iOS/Android apps let the business number be answered from a cell phone. No evidence explicitly shows forwarding the business number to an external cell number, or schedule/away-based forwarding. Missing for 10: explicit call forwarding to an external phone number, business-hours or away-time forwarding rules, in-depth docs, independent corroboration.
